sections.title: Day 2 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天延續 Day 1 的基礎訓練，主題是 **五大句型 S / V / O / C + Part 2 疑問句判斷 + Part 5 詞性進階**。由於目前還沒有 Day 1 的實際答題紀錄可供調整，今天先維持「860+ 基礎養成」難度；之後有作答結果時，再依錯題類型提高或降低難度。

今天建議 **90～110 分鐘**。先做題，再看解析。

sections.title: ① 今日 TOEIC 高頻單字 30 個
sections.markdown:

### 今天優先記這 8 組

**meeting agenda**

**give a presentation**

**submit a proposal**

**within budget**

**sign a contract**

**reach an agreement**

**meet a deadline**

**request an extension**

> We need to **meet the deadline**.

不是「遇見截止日期」，而是「如期完成／趕上期限」。

sections.title: ② 今日文法：五大句型 S / V / O / C
sections.markdown:
這是 Reading Part 5 很重要的底層能力。看到英文時，先不要急著翻成中文，先找：**誰 → 做什麼 → 對誰／什麼**。

### 第一型：S + V

> The meeting ended.

The meeting = S；ended = V。這類動詞不需要受詞，常見動詞有 arrive、occur、happen、remain。

### 第二型：S + V + C

> The conference room is available.

conference room = S；is = V；available = C。C 是補充描述主詞，常見結構為 **be + adjective**。

### 第三型：S + V + O

> The manager approved the proposal.

manager = S；approved = V；proposal = O。也就是「主管 → 核准 → 提案」。

### 第四型：S + V + O + O

> The company sent customers an email.

company = S；sent = V；customers = O；email = O。常見動詞有 send、give、offer、show。

### 第五型：S + V + O + C

> The company considers the project successful.

company = S；considers = V；project = O；successful = C。successful 是在描述 project。

sections.title: ③ Part 5 解題技巧
sections.markdown:
> The manager considered the proposal _____.

(A) favor

(B) favorable

(C) favorably

(D) favored

結構：manager = S；considered = V；proposal = O；空格 = C。C 在描述 proposal，所以需要**形容詞**。答案是 **B — favorable**。

這就是為什麼學句型很重要。不是把四個選項全部翻譯，而是**先判斷空格需要什麼詞性**。

sections.title: ④ Listening｜Part 2 疑問句進階
sections.markdown:
Day 1 練習 Who → 人、When → 時間、Where → 地點、Why → 原因；今天增加 **How / Which / What**。

### Q1

> Which conference room should we use?

(A) Room 305 is available.

(B) About thirty people.

(C) At two o'clock.

Which → 選擇。答案：**A**。

### Q2

> How did you travel to the conference?

(A) Last Tuesday.

(B) By train.

(C) About three hours.

How → 方法。答案：**B**。

### Q3

> What time does the presentation begin?

(A) The sales presentation.

(B) In the auditorium.

(C) At ten thirty.

What time → 時間。答案：**C**。

### 間接回答

> Where is Mr. Chen?

初階答案是 In his office.，但 TOEIC 很可能回答 He went to meet a client.。這句沒有直接回答在哪裡，卻可以推論他不在這裡。

> Has Ms. Lee finished the report?

(A) I'll ask her.

(B) On the desk.

(C) Three pages.

答案：**A**。回答不是 Yes / No，而是「我去問她」，這就是 TOEIC Part 2 很重要的 **Indirect Response**。

sections.title: ⑤ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
> **To:** Marketing Department
> **From:** Daniel Wu
> **Subject:** Product Presentation
> The presentation for our new software product has been moved from Wednesday morning to Thursday afternoon because several members of the sales team will be attending a conference on Wednesday.
> The presentation will now begin at 2:00 P.M. in Conference Room 305. Please review the updated presentation materials before the meeting.
> If you cannot attend, notify me by Tuesday afternoon.

### Q1

Why was the presentation rescheduled?

(A) The conference room is unavailable.

(B) Some employees will attend a conference.

(C) The software is not ready.

(D) The manager requested more time.

答案：**B**。定位：several members ... will be attending a conference。

### Q2

When will the presentation take place?

(A) Tuesday afternoon

(B) Wednesday morning

(C) Thursday morning

(D) Thursday afternoon

答案：**D**。

### Q3

What are employees asked to do before the presentation?

(A) Review some materials

(B) Contact customers

(C) Reserve a room

(D) Submit an expense report

答案：**A**。定位：review the updated presentation materials。

sections.title: ⑥ TOEIC 仿真題
sections.markdown: 這部分先自己完成，再到「階段小考」作答與查看解析。共 8 題，重點是詞性、動詞形式與常見搭配。

sections.title: ⑦ 今日小考｜10 題
sections.markdown: 先記錄答案，再看解析。請到「階段小考」選擇 Day 2 小考完成 10 題。

sections.title: ⑧ 答案與解析
sections.markdown:
### 仿真題答案

**1 B / 2 C / 3 B / 4 C / 5 B / 6 C / 7 D / 8 A**

> The project was completed **successfully**.

completed 已經是動詞，要修飾動詞，所以使用副詞 successfully。

> The campaign was **successful**.

be 動詞後描述 campaign，所以使用形容詞 successful。

**success** → 名詞

**succeed** → 動詞

**successful** → 形容詞

**successfully** → 副詞

### 小考答案

**1 A / 2 C / 3 B / 4 C / 5 B / 6 B / 7 A / 8 B / 9 A / 10 B**

Q8 特別重要：Has Mr. Wang approved the budget? 答案不是 Yes / No，而是 I'll check with his assistant.，這就是今天的 **Indirect Response**。

sections.title: ⑨ Day 1 錯題複習
sections.markdown:
今天再複習 Day 1 最重要的詞性概念。

### available / availability

> The room is **available**.

available 是形容詞。

> Please check room **availability**.

availability 是名詞。

### approve / approval

> The manager will **approve** it.

approve 是動詞。

> We need your **approval**.

approval 是名詞。

### qualify / qualified / qualification

> Applicants must **qualify**.

qualify 是動詞。

> We need a **qualified** applicant.

qualified 是形容詞。

> She has the necessary **qualifications**.

qualification 是名詞。這種同一字根不同詞性會一路貫穿 Part 5。

sections.title: ⑩ 今日作業與金色證書觀念
sections.markdown:
今天完成三輪。

第一輪，把今天 30 個單字快速複習一次，特別記：**proposal / budget / contract / negotiate / agreement / notify / require / deadline / extension**。

第二輪，把下面句子直接理解，不翻成逐字中文：

> The manager approved the proposal.
> We need to meet the deadline.
> The company negotiated a new contract.
> Please notify employees of the change.
> She requested an extension.

第三輪，睡前重新完成今天的 **10 題小考**。目標：**10 / 10，並且每題能說出為什麼。**

### Day 2 金色證書觀念

> **先看句子結構，再看單字意思。**

看到 The project was completed _____.，先想 completed 是動詞，空格修飾動詞，所以需要副詞。因此即使不知道完整句意，也能迅速選出 successfully。這種解題方式會直接影響未來 Part 5 能不能從 20 分鐘以上壓縮到約 10 分鐘。

下一階段會進入 **Day 3：名詞、動詞、形容詞、副詞完整辨識 + Part 5 詞性陷阱 + Part 2 間接回答進階 + Part 7 定位閱讀**。

questions.prompt: The manager asked the staff to _____ the report before Friday.
questions.explanation: ask + 人 + to + 原形動詞，因此使用 complete。

questions.prompt: The company's new advertising campaign has been extremely _____.
questions.explanation: be 動詞後描述 campaign，需要形容詞 successful。

questions.prompt: All conference _____ must register at the front desk.
questions.explanation: all conference 後需要表示人的複數名詞 participants。

questions.prompt: The project was completed _____ despite several unexpected delays.
questions.explanation: 副詞 successfully 修飾動詞 completed。

questions.prompt: Ms. Lin will _____ the results during tomorrow's meeting.
questions.explanation: will 後使用原形動詞 present。

questions.prompt: The company plans to _____ a new contract with its supplier.
questions.explanation: plan to 後使用原形動詞 negotiate。

questions.prompt: Employees were _____ of the schedule change by email.
questions.explanation: 員工被通知，使用被動語態 were notified。

questions.prompt: The project remained _____ budget despite the delay.
questions.explanation: within budget 是『在預算內』的固定搭配。

questions.prompt: The director will _____ the proposal this afternoon.
questions.explanation: will 後使用原形動詞 review。

questions.prompt: Our company recently hired three highly _____ engineers.
questions.explanation: 空格修飾 engineers，需要形容詞 qualified。
than 表示比較，因此使用比較級 earlier。

questions.prompt: The marketing team gave an excellent _____ yesterday.
questions.explanation: excellent 修飾名詞，因此使用 presentation。

questions.prompt: Employees must receive _____ before making purchases over $1,000.
Where will tomorrow's conference be held?
questions.explanation: Where 詢問地點，因此選 At the Grand Hotel。
Why 詢問原因，因此選運輸延誤。

questions.prompt: Has Mr. Wang approved the budget?
questions.explanation: 這是合理的間接回答：我會向他的助理確認。
Who 詢問人物，因此選 Ms. Huang。

questions.prompt: When should I submit the application?
questions.explanation: When 詢問時間，因此選 By Friday。

keyTakeaway: 先看句子結構，再看單字意思。
